findings_summary: 2 major + 3 minor/observed amendments, no blockers. M-01 (major): A6 lists AuthorizationPolicies.cs as sole writer to 'widen' pricing/quote, but its own ACs Quote_Anonymous_BySlug_Returns200 AND Quote_Dispatcher_Returns200 can only both pass via AllowAnonymous() + tenant-resolved guard (ListCommonRoutesEndpoint precedent); every existing policy uses RequireAuthenticatedUser() which 401s the anonymous-by-slug path — so the AuthorizationPolicies.cs edit is wrong, not just unnecessary. Fix: A6 widens via AllowAnonymous()+ (FleetId is null -> 400) guard and DROPS the AuthorizationPolicies.cs change. M-02 (major): B1 renames quote request args (fromLat->pickupLat) + response discriminant (priceType->type) and changes usePriceQuote.ts's getPriceQuote call, but CustomOrderPage.test.tsx (mocks getPriceQuote on the old shape) is NOT in B1 files_touched — the UC-004 customer-order test breaks. Fix: add web/src/features/customer/order/CustomOrderPage.test.tsx to B1 files_touched + migrate its mock. O-01 (observed, non-blocking): routes/common IsWithinWindow does not wrap midnight while A6 RouteMatcher does — but AC#5 uses non-wrapping 03:00-04:00 and A5/A6 must NOT touch ListCommonRoutesEndpoint; latent follow-up only. O-02 (minor): A6 POST body + B1 client body must use byte-identical {pickupLat,pickupLng,dropoffLat?,dropoffLng?,at?}. O-03 (minor, verified safe): A7 adds priceOverrideReason as trailing-optional to OrderDetailDto (last 3 params already optional; Order.PriceOverrideReason exists) so all ~6 callers keep compiling under -warnaserror.
verified_sound: A6 Zone-no-dropoff correction is real: QuoteEndpoint guards 'if (toLat.HasValue && toLng.HasValue)' (line 83) before any route match, so current code cannot satisfy AC#2 'anywhere in KH -> Fixed 110' with no dropoff — A6 must run the matcher independent of the dropoff branch. pricing/quote replacement forced: old QuoteResponse(PriceType,FixedPriceCzk,EstimateLowCzk,EstimateHighCzk), GET, CustomerOnly, no Meter, no-dropoff->wide-Estimate; getPriceQuote consumers all inside B1 scope except the M-02 test gap. routes/common canonical: CommonRouteDto is a superset of routes/available {id,name,type,priceCzk,fromLabel,toLabel}; A5 must not touch ListCommonRoutesEndpoint. Price-lock structural: CreateOrderEndpoint copies PriceType/EstimatedPriceCzk/FixedPriceCzk/RouteId into the order row at creation (lines 175-178) -> A7 integration-test-only is correct. Migrations: only A1 Route ALTER + A2 Place CREATE, Zone already exists with jsonb Polygon JsonDocument, serialized A1->A2, no other WI adds a migration. jsonb trap: Zone.Polygon is JsonDocument? -> ToListAsync-then-read-in-memory (CLAUDE.md WI-10). ZoneService (haversine circle + ray-casting polygon, boundary convention) + RouteMatcher (precedence/bidirectional/midnight-wrap Europe-Prague) mapped to A3/A6 unit tests (AC#1). Multi-tenancy: Zone/Place/Route ITenantEntity, per-feature isolation tests, anonymous paths fleet-safe by slug. Leaflet lazy (B2). Shared-file writers (ErrorCodes.cs, DevelopmentSeeder.cs, client.ts) serialized via depends_on <=2 concurrent. All 12 WIs complete.
disposition: blocks_merge=false; every finding is a foldable dev-brief amendment. A6: M-01 (widen pricing/quote via AllowAnonymous()+tenant-guard per ListCommonRoutesEndpoint precedent; DROP the AuthorizationPolicies.cs edit) + O-02 (POST body field names {pickupLat,pickupLng,dropoffLat?,dropoffLng?,at?} byte-identical with B1) + the Zone-no-dropoff matcher correction. B1: M-02 (add CustomOrderPage.test.tsx to files_touched, migrate its getPriceQuote mock to the discriminated-union 'type' shape + pickup*/dropoff* args). A7 correct as written (O-03). O-01 recorded as observed latent — do NOT make A5 touch ListCommonRoutesEndpoint. Work-items doc not re-issued. Roslyn pass N/A (MCP not configured).
